description: Get one record by id, with all its fields as the KB user can see them. Use agiloft_list_tables to find the table and its fields. Agiloft REST: EWRead.

table.description: Table logical name, case sensitive (for example case or contacts.employees).

name: agiloft_get_record
title: Get a record

description: List the tables of the Agiloft knowledgebase (label and logical name). Pass table and include_fields=true to get that table's fields. Use the logical names in the other tools. Agiloft REST: EWTable.

include_fields.description: true = also return the fields of the table (needs table).

name: agiloft_list_tables
title: List tables

description: Search a table with an ad hoc query (for example summary~='test'&&priority=3; ~= means contains) and return the number of matches and the requested fields. Pages with page and limit. Agiloft REST: EWSearch.

fields.description: Logical field names to return with each record.

query.description: Ad hoc query in Agiloft syntax, for example status='Open'. Leave empty for all records.

table.description: Table logical name, case sensitive (for example case or contacts.employees).

name: agiloft_search_records
title: Search records
